# /etc/systemd/system/nebius-vpngw-fix-routes.service
[Unit]
Description=Fix Nebius VPN Gateway routing issues
Documentation=https://github.com/nebius/nebius-ps-services
After=network-online.target strongswan-starter.service frr.service
Wants=network-online.target strongswan-starter.service frr.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/nebius-vpngw/config-resolved.yaml

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment="PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1"
ExecCondition=/usr/bin/python3 -m nebius_vpngw.agent.main --vm-ha-route-maintenance-ready
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m nebius_vpngw.agent.fix_routes --config /etc/nebius-vpngw/config-resolved.yaml
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
